fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Main heading for the block (optional, used in 'support-cards-with-header' variant).

fields.name: subheading
fields.label: Subheading
fields.description: Subheading/introductory text for the block (optional, used in 'support-cards-with-header' variant).

fields.name: col1_item_icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Reference to an image or SVG for the card icon (optional, used in 'icon-cards' variant).

fields.name: col1_item_icon_background_color
fields.label: Icon Background Color
fields.description: Hex code for the circular background color of the icon (optional, used in 'icon-cards' variant).

fields.name: col2_item_description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Body text/description for the card. Allows for inline links.

fields.name: col3_item_cta
fields.label: CTA Link
fields.description: URL for the Call-to-Action button (optional, not used in 'support-cards-with-header' variant).

fields.name: col3_item_ctaText
fields.label: CTA Label
fields.description: Text for the Call-to-Action button (optional, not used in 'support-cards-with-header' variant).
